verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a preview command that shows planned changes without applying them, and CLI exit codes meant for CI/CD systems. A community user also reports running Pulumi in CI/CD pipelines, so the non-interactive core of the story is supported. The evidence never shows saving a preview as a plan artifact for a later apply, or any approval/auto-confirm flag. missing for 10: saved plan artifacts consumed by apply, documented non-interactive approval flags (e.g. skip-confirmation), first-party CI workflow docs tying preview to apply.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can run plan and apply non-interactively in CI using saved plan artifacts and approval flags

citations.quote: No changes to the stack will actually take place.
Scripts, CI/CD systems, and tools can use these codes
Their company runs Pulumi in the CI/CD pipeline of all microservices.
